title: Event homelabnext.agent.activity
description: One agent activity event of the SUMMARY tier (data is schemas/status/agent_activity.schema.json): names, counts and outcomes, never a prompt, command, tool input or output. The private detail tier never goes on the bus. The status hub publishes it so other consumers can follow agent sessions (ADR-0013 stage 1b). The id derives from the activity event_id, so a re-sent event is a duplicate.
